title: Create immersive media experiences for visionOS - Day 2
description: Learn how to create compelling interactive experiences for visionOS and capture immersive video in this multi-day live streamed activity. On Day 1, we’ll show how visionOS 26 can help you tell impactful immersive and interactive stories. You’ll learn how to frame your creative ideas for formats like Apple Immersive Video and explore real-world examples from past productions. You’ll discover how to design for spatial interaction and tell stories that make the audience part of your experience. And you’ll find out how to use SharePlay and spatial Personas to help people connect over your ideas. On Day 2, we’ll dive deep into Apple Immersive Video with Apple Spatial Audio. You’ll discover how to create entirely new media experiences, get started with Apple Immersive Video, explore new production workflows, and dig into previous Apple Immersive productions.
